prompt: Our chat backend exposes `POST /chat/stream`, which is supposed to push model tokens to the browser as they're generated over Server-Sent Events. QA just filed a bug: the client's status indicator flips to "streaming" the instant the request opens, but the chat bubble stays completely blank for the whole generation, then the full answer appears all at once in one burst at the end — total generation time hasn't changed, only the user-perceived latency has. Here's the current handler. Walk me through every point along this path that's re-buffering the stream, and give me the concrete per-frame fix plus any transport hardening needed so a proxy in front of this service can't undo it — then tell me how you'd prove the fix actually works end-to-end.
